faq.title: Frequently Asked
faq.lead: Find answers to common questions about our farming practices, services, and solutions.

items.question: How do I create a vegetable Agriculture?
items.answer: Start with soil that drains well, pick seasonal vegetables, and follow a simple watering plan. We can map the first crop cycle with you.

items.question: How Farming during the winter months?
items.answer: Use cold-tolerant crops, cover the beds, and water in the morning so the soil does not stay wet overnight.

items.question: How do I prevent in my Agriculture?
items.answer: Check leaves often, keep the field clean, and treat pests early with the method that fits your crop.

items.question: What are the prerequisites course?
items.answer: No prior course is required. A short intro call is enough to start, and we share the basics before the first visit.
